NAMES                            STATUS             PORTS
audiominer-local-web-service-1   Up About an hour   127.0.0.1:8090->8090/tcp
audiominer-local-fs-watcher-1    Up About an hour   
audiominer-local-redis-1         Up About an hour   6379/tcp
audiominer-local-asr-service-1   Up 3 minutes       127.0.0.1:8091->8090/tcp
---
8090: HTTP 200
8091: HTTP 200
 M deployments/example-opencode/asr-service.cpu.default.yml

observation.command: export DOCKER_HOST=unix:///var/run/docker.sock; docker ps --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}'; echo "---"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "8090: HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8090/; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "8091: HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8091/; cd /workspace && git status --short
